mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_ORGANIZATION (ID, ORG_ID, TENANT_ID, PARENT_ORG_REF_ID, ORG_CODE, ORG_NAME, STATUS, SORT_NUM, VERSION, IS_DELETE, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{orgId}, #{tenantId}, #{parentOrgRefId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgCode}, #{orgName}, 'ENABLE', 0, 0, 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_ORGANIZATION SET IS_DELETE = 1, STATUS = 'DISABLE', DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFY_TIME = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), MODIFIER_ID = #{operatorRefId} WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantBusinessId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND IS_DELETE = 0
